task: Classify each case as an intent router. Use only the case text. Do not read any other files or use tools. Output one prediction per case.

intents.answer_only: A question, explanation, fact lookup, diagnosis, or read-only review; no request to change or fix anything, run builds/tests, create lifecycle assets, or release.
intents.code_task: Implement, modify, refactor, or verify code or configuration; includes running tests/builds and executing an already-defined plan.
intents.bug_fix: The user asks to fix a defect or produce a fix approach, not only diagnose it.
intents.plan_decision: Produce a plan, design, architecture, tradeoff, migration or rollback strategy, or a decision before implementation; includes cross-module or high-risk changes that need a plan first.
intents.asset_lifecycle: Create, update, record, or settle Knowledge, Acceptance, or ADR assets.
intents.release: Bump the version, publish, package, update CHANGELOG, or sync downstream projects.
intents.docs_change: Create or update documentation as the main deliverable; not documentation that is only part of a release or code change.

policy: Only include modules the task actually needs. Mere mentions of a topic do not add a module.
If the target, deliverable, or scope is too vague to start, set must_clarify=true, modules=[], triggers=["clarify_required"], and keep the most likely tentative intents (or []).
If the user explicitly says not to use Harness, add direct_override.
For code_task, add code_edit for code/config changes and code_verify when the action is running tests/builds.
Multi-intent tasks include every required intent and the union of their modules.
Do not add plan/assets/release/docs just because those words appear; require an actual corresponding request.

cases.setup: 两个日志文件覆盖同一故障窗口，用户只要求还原时间线。
